runs.name: p33_within_pair_discrimination
runs.note: WPRD: a prior-free relational-grounding metric. Within an (s,o) group the train-derived prior is constant to 9.4e-05, so in the double difference (score[i,a]-score[i,b]) - (score[j,a]-score[j,b]) the prior, any per-class calibration, tau and any global temperature all cancel EXACTLY. What survives varies only with the image. Scores both predicate heads, including the classifier head the checkpoint discards at ensemble_alpha=0. Motivated by the finding that 43.1% of rows are structurally inert to the p26/p29 pair-matched null.

runs.name: p34_ensemble_alpha_sweep
runs.note: Does the predicate head the checkpoint discards at ensemble_alpha=0 actually help at the operating point? runs/p33 found the discarded classifier head has strictly better prior-free within-pair relational discrimination (WPRD 0.5728 vs 0.5542, non-overlapping CIs). This sweeps ea and reports R@50/mR@50/Pareto plus WPRD per alpha on the same p24 full cache.

runs.name: p35_wprd_stratified
runs.note: Where does relational grounding live? p33's macro (0.5542) and weighted (0.5266) WPRD disagree, and weighting by cell size pulls toward chance. Tests whether the model's image-conditioned discrimination is INVERSELY related to pair support -- weakest where the pair prior is strongest. Also bounds the dilution from same-instance rows (VG annotates one instance pair with several predicates; those tie at 0.5 by construction).

runs.note: Capstone: drops the project's own WPRD metric and uses the FIELD'S metric. Swaps the checkpoint's model term for a train-fitted linear probe on 19 box-geometry features, normalised exactly as the evaluator normalises its heads, inside the exact composition score = 3.75*(prior - tau*logP) + term. runs.name: p42_within_group_decomp
runs.note: Separates the four quantities p32's interpretation requires. (1) WPRD is invariant to anything constant within a group, so the 82.6% between-group share of the model term contributes EXACTLY ZERO to it -- WPRD and R@50 read different halves. Gated by recomputing WPRD on the group-centred term and requiring bit-equality. (2) Splits the within-group component into a box-geometry-predictable part and a residual, cross-fitted out-of-fold on the project's own folds, and measures WPRD of each. Tests directly whether the checkpoint's within-pair discrimination is layout or something else. CPU only; p36 owns the GPU.

runs.name: p43_prior_adversarial
runs.note: C7 of the benchmark prototype. On rows where following P(p|s,o) is WRONG (prior argmax != GT; the prior is train-derived so this population is defined without touching validation labels), does the model fix them, and at what cost on the rows the prior already had right? Reports benefit and cost together.

runs.name: p44_prior_absorption
runs.note: Tests the single principle that would explain the whole cycle: PRIOR ABSORPTION -- the visual pathway is optimised to predict P(p|s,o) rather than to deviate from it, because deviation is penalised on average even though it is exactly what the 33.4% prior-adversarial rows require. Sharp falsifiable prediction: the model's OUTPUT should be MORE determined by (s,o) than the GROUND TRUTH is. Measured by within-group label entropy and by best pair-constant predictor accuracy, on decidable rows.

runs.name: p45_within_pair_composition
runs.note: Pre-registered in docs/WITHIN_PAIR_COMPOSITION_PREREGISTRATION.md (commit d6494a1) before this tool was written. Tests p44's PRIOR OVERWRITE prediction: amplifying only the within-group component of the model term at decision time should recover a disproportionate share of prior-adversarial rows, with no retraining. Transductive headroom diagnostic; both nulls carried.

runs.name: p46_geometry_ceiling
runs.note: Calibration the diagnosis was missing: is WPRD 0.5542 low, or near what VG150 permits? Within a group the subject label, object label and prior are all CONSTANT, so only pixels and boxes vary. The box channel's ceiling is therefore measurable on CPU with no model. Compares a train-fitted MLP against the train-fitted linear probe and both heads, with a shuffled-label MLP control. CPU only; p36 owns the GPU.

runs.name: p47_evaluation_table
runs.note: The Paper-1 table. Emits R@50/mR@50/Pareto (which conflate pair prior, calibration, candidate selection and relational discrimination) beside WPRD (which isolates the last) and WPRD by predicate bucket, for every arm on identical cells. Model-agnostic: --extra name=path.pt accepts any per-pair predicate logits in the cache's row order and vocabulary, so a cross-model study is not blocked on any one codebase.

runs.name: p48_objective_ablation
runs.note: H2 test that does not need rel_feat. Holds features (19 box-geometry numbers), capacity (2-layer 256 MLP), data (train split) and evaluation (WPRD on the same val cells) FIXED, and varies only the loss: plain cross-entropy vs a within-group contrastive surrogate for WPRD itself. The prior cancels in the contrastive double difference, so the objective cannot be satisfied by learning P(p|s,o). Criterion pre-registered inline: SUPPORTED >= +0.02, WEAK >= +0.005. The identical comparison transfers to rel_feat when p36 lands.

runs.name: p49_metric_grounding
runs.note: Addresses the n=4 weakness in p47. Widens the family to twelve scoring functions, all composed and evaluated identically, and computes Spearman rank correlation between each composed metric and WPRD with a permutation p-value. These are NOT published SGG models -- that study remains the gate on any general claim -- but this can establish whether the inversion is systematic across a diverse family or an accident of which four arms were in the table.

runs.name: p4_bench_clip_l14_336
runs.note: Measured ViT-L/14-336 throughput + VRAM at batch 16/32/48/64 on the L4, real crops, fp16 autocast, inference_mode. Chooses batch size from data for the appearance probe.

runs.name: p4_decision_rule_sweep
runs.note: Pre-registered decision-rule test (docs/DECISION_RULE_HYPOTHESIS.md). tau=0 verified numerically identical to frequency_prior_baseline (test_decision_rule_probe.py).

runs.name: p4_predicate_discriminability
runs.note: Phase 4 Q4/Q5: re-measure whether geometry separates confusable predicate pairs in BALANCED BINARY form, contradicting the flat-softmax 0.0% result

runs.name: p50_supervision_structure
runs.note: Dataset-level diagnosis prompted by p48. A model can only learn to distinguish predicate a from b WITHIN a fixed (s,o) group if training data contains rows of BOTH for the SAME group. Measures exactly how many such comparisons exist, per split and per predicate-bucket combination. No causal claim: this measures what supervision exists, not that its scarcity causes any model behaviour. CPU only; p36 owns the GPU.

runs.name: p51_readout_geometry
runs.note: Tests the hypothesis p50 pointed to: the text head is a cosine against FIXED, never-trained CLIP predicate embeddings, so its ability to separate two predicates is bounded by the angle between them regardless of rel_feat or supervision. pred_emb lives only in the p36 cache, but the column correlation matrix of the stored logits is a proxy for the embedding Gram matrix, and var(logits[:,a] - logits[:,b]) is the discriminative BUDGET that readout has for the pair. Predicts a negative association for the text head and a weaker one for the learned classifier head.

runs.name: p52_supervision_vg150only
runs.note: ROBUSTNESS CHECK on p50, prompted by discovering that datasets_vg150_clean retains RAW Visual Genome object names (16,929 distinct; 55.8% of object mentions outside the standard VG150 150-category vocabulary). p50's groups were therefore at raw-name granularity, which makes groups smaller and within-pair supervision look scarcer than standard VG150 would. This re-runs the identical analysis restricted to relationships whose BOTH endpoints are in the 150-category vocabulary.

runs.name: p53_FAILED_keyerror
runs.note: ROBUSTNESS: replicate p49's metric-vs-grounding rank correlation on the STANDARD VG150 subset only (both endpoints in the 150-category vocabulary), after discovering datasets_vg150_clean retains raw VG object names. R@50/mR@50, the tau frontier and WPRD are ALL recomputed on the restricted population so the comparison is internally consistent. Tests whether the mR@50 anti-correlation is a property of the standard benchmark or of this dataset variant.

runs.name: p53_metric_grounding_vg150only
runs.note: ROBUSTNESS: replicate p49 on the STANDARD VG150 subset (both endpoints in the 150-category vocabulary) after discovering datasets_vg150_clean retains raw VG object names. R@50/mR@50, the tau frontier and WPRD are ALL recomputed on the restricted population. Attempt 1 crashed on an empty-group KeyError; see runs/p53_FAILED_keyerror. Unrestricted path regression-tested unchanged (text head 0.5542, prior 0.5000).

runs.note: Pre-registered held-out replication on the VG150 TEST split (docs/TEST_SPLIT_REPLICATION_PREREGISTRATION.md). Identical to runs/p36_relfeat_cache in every flag except --eval_split_name test and output paths. Frozen forward pass, no training, no gradient. GPU verified idle (0 MiB, 0 percent, no compute apps) immediately before launch; 2-batch smoke on split=test passed and the dump contract (rel_feat, pred_emb) was verified. No registered threshold altered.

runs.name: p55_objective_relfeat
runs.note: Pre-registered in docs/OBJECTIVE_ABLATION_RELFEAT_PREREGISTRATION.md (commit 75b1e8e), before the tool existed. The registered transfer of p48 from box geometry to rel_feat, with p48's supervision-supply confound fixed by C_ce_matched (CE restricted to exactly the rows the contrastive arm may learn from). Cross-fitted over 5 validation folds split by image, identical construction to p37. Optimisation budget matched as well as data: contrastive acceptance ~32 percent, so pairs-per-epoch 200000 yields ~64k accepted pairs per fold per epoch against C_ce_matched's ~57.7k rows. CPU only, runs beside the p54 GPU pass. Thresholds inherited from p48 unchanged.

runs.name: p56_supervision_scaling
runs.note: Pre-registered in docs/SUPERVISION_SCALING_PREREGISTRATION.md (commit 25b1450), before the tool existed. The registered H6-vs-H8 discriminator: if supervision scarcity explains p37's representation limit, the checkpoint's WPRD should rise with the training supervision its (s,o) pair received; geometry, fitted globally over 19 shared features, is the control that cannot manufacture that signature. Part C measures directly what per-pair supervision buys on a channel known to carry signal. One block is labelled EXPLORATORY, NOT A CRITERION: it was added after a pilot showed the classifier head's bin means trending while the registered cell-level Spearman read ~0, and it changes no threshold and decides no verdict. CPU only, runs beside the p54 GPU pass and p55.

runs.name: p57_FAILED_constant_column
runs.note: Pre-registered in docs/GEOMETRY_DECODABILITY_PREREGISTRATION.md (commit db6dec3), before the tool existed. After p55/p56 closed the readout, objective and supervision routes, H6 survives only by elimination; this asks whether the 19 box features a linear probe uses to beat rel_feat are even linearly present inside rel_feat. CPU only, runs beside the p54 GPU pass.

runs.name: p57_geometry_decodability
runs.note: Pre-registered in docs/GEOMETRY_DECODABILITY_PREREGISTRATION.md (commit db6dec3). Attempt 2. Attempt 1 (runs/p57_FAILED_constant_column) reported a verdict produced by a division artifact: _standardise appends a constant bias column whose zero variance made its R2 evaluate to -1.4e13. Constant targets are now screened out and gate X1 is two-sided. No registered threshold changed. CPU only, beside the p54 GPU pass.

runs.name: p58_VOID_lambda_grid_too_narrow
runs.note: Pre-registered in docs/GEOMETRY_FUSION_PREREGISTRATION.md (commit 8f35fff), before the tool existed. Replaces p37's R9, which compared a 788-d validation-cross-fitted ridge against a 20-d train-fitted CE probe and read the difference as a fact about the features. Every arm here shares one regime: same folds, same estimator, same nested lambda search by inner-fold log-loss, same preprocessing. Arm F (random-768 + geometry) isolates dimensionality. CPU only, 4 threads, runs beside the p54 GPU pass which is NOT touched.

runs.name: p58_geometry_fusion
runs.note: Attempt 2. Attempt 1 (runs/p58_VOID_lambda_grid_too_narrow) was VOIDED by its own registered gate Y5: every arm saturated against the lambda grid's 1e-4 floor on every fold, so the nested search never chose anything. Grid widened to 1e-8..1e0. Gate Y5 and every verdict threshold are unchanged from docs/GEOMETRY_FUSION_PREREGISTRATION.md (commit 8f35fff). CPU only, beside the untouched p54 GPU pass.
